children: On October 28, 2026, REDWOOD CAPITAL BANCORP (the Company), (

), the only locally owned and operated community bank holding company in Humboldt County, announced unaudited financial results for the three and nine-month period ended September 30, 2026. Redwood Capital Bank (the Bank), the Company’s wholly owned subsidiary, reported consistent earnings.

Jennifer P. Budwig, President commented, “During the third quarter of 2026, the Company remains well-capitalized with a capital ratio of 11.26% at quarter-end. Throughout the third quarter of 2026, Redwood Capital Bank experienced consistent growth in net interest margin at 4.23%. Gross loans are up $29.4 million year to date. Overall, the Bank’s balance sheet remains strong, while earnings remain consistent. As of the third quarter of 2026, tangible book value has risen 7% to $30.46 with earnings per share (EPS) increasing 28% to $2.52 per share compared to the same period in 2025. These results reflect the Board of Directors and the management team’s commitment to the Company’s long-term performance.”

Budwig added, “I am pleased to announce Redwood Capital Bank's expansion into Shasta County with the establishment of a non-branch, Loan Production Office (LPO) in Redding, California. This exciting new chapter allows us to extend our relationship-focused approach to commercial lending into the greater Redding area. Equally exciting is Redwood Capital Bank’s recent certification as a Community Development Financial Institution (CDFI), an important milestone that reinforces our mission as a community bank. This designation provides additional opportunities to expand access to capital, support local businesses and strengthen the communities we serve. As we look ahead, we remain focused on responsible growth, exceptional customer service and making a meaningful difference in the lives of our customers and communities.”

The Company’s total assets as of September 30, 2026, were $553.7 million. Total deposits stood at $495 million as of September 30, 2026. Total loans as of September 30, 2026, net of unearned income, were $411.1 million. Net income for the third quarter of 2026 was strong at $1,759,000. Net interest income for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, totaled $5,684,000 and $16,420,000 respectively. The Company also reported net income for the first nine months of 2026 of $4,706,000.

Additionally, the Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.10 per share, payable on November 12, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on October 26, 2026. The dividend is equivalent to an annual rate of $0.40 per share or 1.16%, based upon a market price of $34.61 per common share.

For more information regarding Redwood Capital Bancorp, please visit our website at www.redwoodcapitalbank.com, contact Renee Byers, CFO, at (707) 444-9849, or stop by our headquarters and main office at 402 “G” Street, Eureka, CA 95501. Redwood Capital Bancorp (
